body:
Soap, gloves, and two water jugs, paid cash. On the back: "Trial crew used the sink at dawn. My eyes burned and the basil on the sill turned brown."

I saved it from the bag of rubbish because the note named the sink. The things stacked beside the page were real enough, and still waiting to be moved.
title: Soap bought after the field run

body:
The shelves were emptied twice. The first group took food; the second stepped over the broken glass to ask for the delivery ledger.

I showed them the register because I had no ledger left. They wanted the names of people who had bought anything that morning, and they wrote down one woman whose son carried the bag. They told me not to mention their visit, and took the register with them.
title: The inventory they took
